reason: B is the better, though imperfect, proposal because nanoscale carbide precipitation is a plausible and directly testable route to retain strength while increasing strain hardening and delaying localization in refractory alloys. A’s central stacking-fault-energy/twinning mechanism and its NiCoCr evidence apply primarily to an FCC alloy and do not adequately support the proposed BCC Nb–Ta–Ti–Zr regime; B should nevertheless reframe carbides as glide obstacles that promote work hardening rather than as phases that facilitate glide.
